top_signals.title: Rio Tinto to Spend $1.9 Billion on Australian Bauxite Expansion
top_signals.summary: Rio Tinto Group will spend $1.9 billion to expand its bauxite mining operations in northern Australia, with the development of a new major mine to replace production from depleting projects.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
